_about: Readings of the landrun re-run of 2026-10-17. A reading of the 2026-10-16 run is carried over where the result is identical; the four escapes new in this run (granted model, SC-003) get the reading nono has for the same contracts.

filesystem-chmod-outside: Landlock does not mediate chmod/utime/xattr; a readable file's metadata can be changed (same gap as nono).
fs-dotdot-absent-root: landrun fails to apply the Landlock ruleset for a writable root spelled with '..' (control broke).
fs-writable-root-symlink-out: a writable root that is a symlink pointing out is followed.
ipc-abstract-unix-socket: abstract-socket scoping needs Landlock ABI 6; this host is ABI 4.
ipc-unix-socket-in-denied-dir-by-omissio: Landlock does not mediate connect() to a pathname unix socket, so a socket in an ungranted directory stays reachable (the same as nono).
isolation-process-info-foreign: landrun is a filesystem and TCP tool (pure Landlock): no name-based trust-handoff protection, no namespaces or seccomp, no process teardown. It does not claim this guarantee.
isolation-seccomp-io-uring-denied: landrun is a filesystem and TCP tool (pure Landlock): no name-based trust-handoff protection, no namespaces or seccomp, no process teardown. It does not claim this guarantee.
isolation-signal-host-process: signal scoping needs Landlock ABI 6; this host is ABI 4.

network-egress-public-denied: Landlock mediates only TCP (ABI 4): UDP, ICMP, netlink, AF_VSOCK and other socket families are not blocked, so the attack's non-TCP leg succeeds.

read-allow-symlink-into-deny-by-omission: The granted read path is itself a symlink into the protected area. Landlock resolves a rule's path when the rule is made, so granting the link grants its target and the secret is read (the same as nono).
read-allow-symlink-no-reopen-by-omission: The granted read path is itself a symlink into the protected area. Landlock resolves a rule's path when the rule is made, so granting the link grants its target and the secret is read (the same as nono).
seccomp-io-uring-denied: landrun has no seccomp; io_uring is not blocked (Landlock does not cover syscalls).
secrets-env-loader-injection-inherit: the policy asked to inherit the whole environment, so LD_PRELOAD passed, as expected.
